description: When BTC and ETH 5m orderbook imbalances agree in direction but SOL or XRP imbalance diverges (opposite sign), bet that BTC resolves in the BTC/ETH consensus direction. Hypothesis: informed flow hits correlated majors first, alt divergence is noise.
hypothesis: Divergent alt-coin book imbalance (SOL/XRP vs BTC/ETH consensus) reflects stale or noise liquidity rather than genuine contrarian information. Fading the outlier captures a reversion premium.
next_steps: Strategy decisively fails: 0/44 parameter configs show positive Sharpe, avg win rate 33% vs 54% base rate. Root cause: the core hypothesis is empirically inverted. All imbalances are NEGATIVELY correlated with BTC Up winning (btc_imb: -0.47, sol_imb: -0.44, xrp_imb: -0.36, eth_imb: -0.17). Positive book imbalance predicts Down, not Up. Furthermore, SOL/XRP imbalances are MORE predictive of BTC outcome than ETH, contradicting the 'alts lag and carry noise' assumption. The divergence signal is actively harmful: when alts diverge, they may carry independent information, not noise. No parameter tuning can rescue a strategy whose directional premise is wrong.
